note: TF's UncraftingMenu itself (default config, every UNCRAFTING_STUFFS value in config). items: for every item, a stack of 64 in the input slot, unrecipeInCycle cycled through every recipe it offers (ingredientsInCycle 0): the recipe, inputCount (items consumed), cost (XP levels, getUncraftingCost) and the 3x3 uncrafting grid row by row ("" empty, "!" prefix = marked: damaged or problematic, cannot be taken); items without options are omitted; truncated lists the items whose options did not wrap around within maxCycles. ingredientCycles: for TF's items and ingredientCycleItems, every option whose ingredients have more than one alternative (after twilightforest:banned_uncrafting_ingredients), ingredientsInCycle 0 .. alternatives-1 (at most maxCycles; truncated otherwise). damaged: every damageable item with options, one item damaged by maxDamage/4, /2 and maxDamage-1, every option. recraft: the cases of tools/oracle/spec.json: the input, its uncrafting grid and cost, the items put into the assembly matrix, the result slot (tinkerResult), getRecraftingCost and getUncraftingCost after. Stacks: "" = empty, an item id = one item without components, else ItemStack's codec {count, components, id}.
